_comment: Merge into ~/.automaton/automaton.json after the setup wizard (or use the install script in money-lab/VPS-SETUP.md). The moneyLab block is strict: unknown or missing keys stop startup. Amounts are USD cents; null means no limit. Secrets are NOT stored here: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and STRIPE_API_KEY come from the environment file. Replace ownerChatId with your Telegram chat id, set stripe.usdPerUnit to today's EUR->USD rate (1 undercounts EUR revenue, which is conservative), and set the VPS daily cost.
genesisPrompt: Owner's optional starting hypotheses (you may ignore all of them): small web tools, practical calculators, printable generators, developer tools, digital templates, narrow APIs, or original niche resources. No revenue model is mandatory.
